data_source.note: inputs hash-bound in every stage receipt; V5/V6/V7 are read-only archives

engine.optimizer: GAM ridge alpha=0.01, scaled inputs + 4-knot cubic speed spline (V6 scientific_models design)

02_Q_predictability.degenerate_rows: Q<1e-12 excluded from a-fit stats only

04_gustiness.derivation: U_g^2 = mu^2 - V^2 = a*Q; U_g = alpha*U_sigma => a = alpha^2
04_gustiness.alpha_selection: train-layer window J W1 only; frozen per layer before test

05_oracle.source_models: 02/03 d02+terrain4 fits per level + full-A fits for B/C
05_oracle.evaluation: identical J, mu, S, P(s) window metrics
05_oracle.verdict: bottleneck=a if W1(O01)-W1(O00) > CI and W1(O10)~W1(O00); symmetric for Q

06_representation.parity: same input columns, same GAM design, same alpha; all reduced to J + moment-matched Weibull P(s)
06_representation.metric: window speed W1 primary; J W1 secondary

07_consistency.gate: all checks pass at every evaluated segment

08_frozen_BC.selection_rule: QA-terrain4 unless a 06 arm beats it at >=4/5 levels (pre-registered); write V8_FROZEN_MODEL.json
08_frozen_BC.bc: fit full A-train once; evaluate B and C once; 120-min paired bootstrap 2000 reps

gates.G_repr: QA not worse than best rival arm at >=4/5 levels
gates.G_gust: state-dependent a (full arm) beats a_const at >=4/5 levels
gates.catastrophic: window W1 or CRPS >1.2 x d02-only stops promotion
